review_notes: I read the whole file and checked its main definitions against Mathlib and the sibling files in this library. The skyscraper/product flasque envelope, the quotient iteration and the cochain complex use generic Mathlib constructions (`∏ᶜ`, `cokernel`, `CochainComplex`) in a named, specific way. I did not count them as duplicates. `homologyIsoCokernelOfKernelFactorization` is a more general variant of Mathlib's `ShortComplex.homologyIsoCokernelLift`. That one is tied to the chosen `kernel` object, while this one takes an arbitrary kernel fork. I judged it a legitimate generalisation and made no finding. The one competing concept I found is `terminalSectionsFunctor`. It is the same functor as Mathlib's `(sheafSections J A).obj (op ⊤)` and as `CompactOpenSections.sections ⊤` in this library. It is also the target of the cohomology isomorphism `functorHZeroIsoSections`. I did not check whether Mathlib already supplies an `Additive` instance for the composite. It may need the file's own proof or a one-line instance.

findings.excerpt:
Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat X ⋙
    (evaluation (Opens X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj (op (⊤ : Opens X))
findings.problem: This introduces a second name for the functor of sections over the terminal open on `AddCommGrpCat`-valued sheaves. Mathlib already has `(sheafSections J A).obj (op T)`, and `sheafSectionsNatIsoEvaluation` shows it is `sheafToPresheaf ⋙ evaluation`, with `Iso.refl` as the isomorphism. `TopCat.Sheaf.forget` is defined as `sheafToPresheaf`. This library also has `CompactOpenSections.sections (⊤ : Opens X)`, which is that same Mathlib functor with `U := ⊤`. `DegreeZero.functorHZeroIsoSections` and the filtered-colimit files use that one. As a result, `flasqueEnvelopeCokernelHZeroIsoCokernelSections` has to move between the two spellings of one functor. The file also re-proves `Additive` for it by hand, so each presentation of the functor needs its own instances.
findings.proposed_change: Drop `terminalSectionsFunctor`. Use `CompactOpenSections.sections (⊤ : Opens X)` (or `(sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat).obj (op ⊤)`) in `flasqueResolutionSections`, the cokernel statements and `flasqueEnvelopeCokernelHZeroIsoCokernelSections`. Keep one `Additive` instance for that single functor. If the short name is wanted, make `terminalSectionsFunctor` a reducible alias of `CompactOpenSections.sections ⊤`, so it is visibly the same functor as in `functorHZeroIsoSections`.
findings.benefit: There is one canonical global-sections functor across the library and Mathlib, so the naturality square with `e₀` no longer depends on unfolding two separate definitions. Instances and simp lemmas written for `sections ⊤` apply here directly. The `Additive` proof is stated once.

evidence.excerpt:
(sheafSections J A).obj (op X) ≅ sheafToPresheaf J A ⋙ (evaluation _ _).obj (op X) :=
  Iso.refl _

def forget : TopCat.Sheaf C X ⥤ TopCat.Presheaf C X :=
  sheafToPresheaf _ _
